identity_preflight: Fetch public GitHub repository metadata for every training/evaluation/prior repository, with validated positive numeric ID, canonical name, explicit public/nonprivate and fork status. For forks require public parent/source and use source ID as network family. Cache validated bounded responses; any missing identity prevents final split. Current SPDX is only a hint, not historical license approval.
network: At most128 new API calls per invocation, starts at least300ms apart,30s per request,2MiB response bound, atomic0700/0600 cache. Offline replay required. Publish normalized public identity inventory and aggregate hashes only, not raw API responses or task identities.
exclusions: Recompute experiment36 pool first. Canonicalize all source repository names from verified IDs; require consistent names/network for aliases. Protect all2594 evaluation rows and prior etcd/Kubernetes/LXD repositories, including matching GitHub fork network families. Reapply existing transitive task component exclusions and deterministic representatives.
partition_units: Union all original training repositories sharing a GitHub network family or lowercase-whitespace-normalized request across any original training rows, including nonrepresentative siblings. Canonical repository identity is indivisible. Every sibling follows its repository role; no outcome-based filtering or cross-role reuse.
assignment: Sort nonempty repository units by SHA256 of length-framed sorted canonical repository names (name tie-break). Assign entire units to final until at least2400 representatives, then validation until at least2400, then all remaining units to train. Require at least4800 train representatives. On shortfall report failure without changing thresholds, retrying seed/order or emitting approved task membership.
validation: No overlap in repository/network units or normalized requests across roles; all candidate representatives assigned exactly once; input permutation invariance, transitive sibling bridges, aliases/forks, missing/private/malformed metadata and undersized partition tests; full data offline/race replay with identical public aggregate and private membership bytes.
interpretation: A fixed identity partition is not an independent-quality result, semantic deduplication guarantee, hidden pretraining contamination check or permission to train/release. No patches, outcomes, model training, final ranking or old final-reserve scoring. Historical licenses and per-file/issue provenance remain separate work before release.
